subject: Final MAP & platform fee proposal for Private/VPC pilot -> staged close plan
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novusai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@novusai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & pricing for Private/VPC pilot

Logan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Leadership is aligned to run a Private/VPC pilot (security + compliance are green to proceed) but procurement/legal need a clear mutual action plan (MAP) tied to pricing and commit milestones before we start procurement. The things we need from Redwood to get an internal PO approved:

- A one-page MAP with milestones, owners, and dates (evaluation, security review, pilot go/no-go, contract signature, production ramp).
- Clear commercial terms: one-time on-prem license fees, ongoing platform fee, token pricing and discount tiers tied to committed ML usage, and any credits during evaluation.
- A proposed ramp schedule (staging -> pilot -> production) and what counts toward committed usage.
- SLA/account coverage and which Redwood contacts will be responsible during the pilot.

Our ask would be to close the contract by mid-Jan to hit a Feb production target. Can Redwood provide a draft MAP and preferred commercial terms by end of week? Also please CC your solutions/legal leads who will own the SOW and license language.

—Sarah Jenkins
CTO, NovusAI

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pricing for Private/VPC pilot

Sarah —

Appreciate the clarity. I've attached a one-page MAP (Redwood-MAP-Nov30.xlsx) and an initial SOW/license draft. High level summary below so procurement has something to circulate immediately:

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Week 0 (Dec 1): Kickoff / exchange security docs (we'll drop SOC2 artifacts into your secure folder) — owner: Redwood (Logan) / Novus (Sarah)
- Week 1-6 (Dec 1–Jan 12): Evaluation pilot (6 weeks) — success criteria: latency <150ms p95 for core flows, accuracy/regression within agreed eval set, traffic shaping test at 25% load. Owner: Marissa
- Week 7-10 (Jan 13–Feb 2): Procurement & contract finalization — target signature by Jan 15 if procurement is on track
- Week 11-14 (Feb 3–Feb 28): Staged production ramp to full capacity

Commercial (initial proposal)
- One-time on-prem license: $120,000 (covers installer + 12 months minor upgrades)
- Platform fee (annual): $60,000 — includes private control plane support, audit log retention, and 24x5 support.
- Token pricing (hosted inference equivalent for on-prem billing): $0.0008 / token (base)
- Commit & discount tiers (annualized):
  * Commit A: $250k/year -> 12% discount on token pricing
  * Commit B: $500k/year -> 20% discount
  * Commit C: $1M+/year -> 28% discount + priority routing guarantees
- Evaluation credits: we propose $15k in token credits during the 6-week pilot; if you sign a minimum 12-month commit at Commit B or higher within 30 days of pilot completion we'll credit back the token charges up to $15k.

Concessions we can make to accelerate:
- Waive the platform fee for the first 3 months of production if Novus signs a 12-month commit at Commit B or higher.
- Flexible invoice terms: Net 45 for first PO; Net 30 standard thereafter.

Open items for legal: on-prem license wording around source access, indemnity, and data residency. Karthik, can legal prepare a short redline for the license and confirm whether the platform fee waiver can be timeboxed in the contract?

Next step: Marissa and I can join your procurement call on Wed; if that works send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novusai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@novusai.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pricing for Private/VPC pilot

Logan —

Thanks for the quick draft — overall this looks promising. A few asks/comments from procurement and engineering after a quick read:

1) Evaluation length: Engineering asks to shorten the pilot to 4–6 weeks (we prefer 6 weeks but would accept 5). Can you confirm Redwood is comfortable with a 5-week target if everything is in place?
2) Platform fee cap: Procurement is ok with the concept of a platform fee but needs an explicit annual cap and statement on recurring vs. one-time components (i.e., support vs. product).
3) Ramp credits: We'd like the evaluation credits to apply toward platform fee and tokens, but prefer at least $25k in combined credits, not $15k.
4) Staging definition: Please define what 'counts' toward committed usage during the staged ramp (i.e., do internal QA runs count?).

We can take the MAP to our budget committee on Dec 7 if we have an updated MAP + commercial terms by EOD Dec 4. Can Redwood get an updated draft with those three changes and send a DocuSign-ready SOW?

—Sarah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novusai.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pricing for Private/VPC pilot

Sarah —

Quick follow from the solutions side with concrete definitions so procurement can gate:

- Pilot duration: Redwood can accept a 5-week pilot target provided Novus confirms test datasets and the staging environment by Dec 6. That gives us time to preload KV caches and run a pre-flight load test.
- Platform fee breakdown (we'll include in an updated SOW):
  * One-time setup & onboarding (1 engineer, 2 weeks): $20k (billed once)
  * Annual platform fee (support + control plane): $60k/year (recurring)
  * Cap: we will cap platform fee increases to CPI + 3% on renewal year-to-year for the initial 24 months.
- Credits: We can increase evaluation credits to $25k combined (tokens + platform), with the following clause: credits applied to the first invoice(s) after signature; if you commit to Commit B or higher for 12 months, we return the credits if they were consumed during evaluation (i.e., full credit back on invoice).
- Committed usage definition: Staging runs (internal QA) up to 10% of total pilot usage will be excluded from committed totals, but external-facing test traffic counts. We'll add an appendix with measurement windows and logging expectations (required for billing reconciliation).

Attached is a CSV with commitment tiers and example annualized spend (commit_tiers_table.csv). Karthik — we'll need legal to review the platform cap wording and the credit return clause.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@novusai.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & pricing for Private/VPC pilot — updated MAP and next steps

Sarah / Procurement —

Attached are the updated artifacts per your asks: Redwood-MAP-Nov30.xlsx (updated), SOW-PrivateDeploy-draft.pdf (DocuSign-ready), commit_tiers_table.csv. Summary of changes:

- Pilot duration set to 5 weeks (Dec 8–Jan 12) contingent on Novus delivering test datasets by Dec 6.
- Evaluation credits increased to $25k combined; credits apply to token billing and the first invoice platform fee; refunded if Novus signs Commit B (>= $500k/yr) within 30 days of signature.
- Platform fee broken into one-time onboarding ($20k) + annual platform fee ($60k). Platform fee waiver: Redwood will waive the first 3 months of the annual platform fee if a 12-month Commit B or greater is signed at contract execution.
- Platform fee cap: CPI + 3% for the first 24 months.
- Committed usage exclusion: internal QA runs up to 10% excluded; appendix added to SOW describing telemetry tags we will use for reconciliation.

Next steps:
1) Please review SOW and MAP and confirm any legal redlines by EOD Dec 9.
2) If green, we'll publish a DocuSign envelope here: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123-Redwood-Novus
3) HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2026-1117-NOVUS (for your reference).

If procurement wants to meet, Marissa and I are available Wed Dec 8 at 10am PST for a 30-min call.

Best —
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
